items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Somewhere around where Lula White's house was at.

ctx.x: In the corner of there of the Custom House in the Basin. Yeah.

Somewhere around where Lula White's house was at. He played around there. And that was Tom Anderson. I remember hearing him saying he played at Tom Anderson when I was at Kidney Shopping. He spoke of the place where he played. I remember that place. Let's see. We had another cabaret on Liberty Street. He played in there but I can't remember the name of that place. I can't remember the name of that cabaret. In fact, I was such a young kid. I wasn't interested in there. I didn't pay much attention to those things…
Wait a minute, I'm not sure. No.
